declarations.description: Pinned React wrapper API; native roles and caller composition are kept separately.

members.name: open
members.description: open/defaultOpen control one panel. Disabled suppresses toggling. onOpenChange carries the boolean and cancellable source details. Closing changes panel presence according to Panel keepMounted/transition options; the caller restores focus before programmatically hiding a currently focused descendant if required.
